numeric.head: 53cb20a8c017eba04bc8dae1437a8179071a1b9d
numeric.method: Summarizes actual GPU output only. CPU rotates geometric normals for comparison and sums recorded GPU contributions. No CPU replacement of depth/normal/AO shader, no renderer, no writes.

findings: The actual GPU wbAO reproduces a secondary occlusion peak at y313 after y304: .939604342 -> .885747731 -> .994971395 at y322. This is not only color grading or PNG statistics.

At y304 and y313 every positive contribution comes from outer-ring taps3/5. Their nearest depth-texel rays hit the same ceiling mesh at station-local y3.263400078, world face normal[0,-1,0]. GPU normals and reconstructed local positions support the ceiling attribution. No suspended board or refrigerator face contributes to this particular secondary peak.

At y304 tap5 L=1.06130743,up=.82906604,facing=1,atten=.18332997,contribution=.15199265; at y313 L=.62639302,up=.72485030,facing=1,atten=.91179782,contribution=.66091692. The increased attenuation weight more than compensates the smaller receiver cosine, raising the contribution. Tap3 decreases from .33117276 to .25310138.

Receiver GPU normals differ from geometric wall normals by <=.01757 degrees; the two contributing ceiling tap normals at y304/313 differ by <=.05157 degrees. A gross receiver-normal mistake is not needed to explain this measured secondary peak. An independent y295 boundary tap differs4.045degrees; do not claim normal reconstruction is globally perfect.

By y304 the inner ring contributes zero. Both circles use a clamped rpx48, so their offsets are19.2/43.2px. This evidence supports examining the fixed screen-radius distribution with Euclidean distance falloff, not a proven universal repair.
limits: Only six centers at x350 and this actual shop camera/time14 were measured. Not a scene-wide proof or performance result.

Actual GPU depth is authoritative. Ceiling tap axial depth differs from nearest-texel geometric ray by .017666.. .022741m; reconstructed sample local y differs by up to about.0068m. Cause of this residual raster/shader-vs-ray discrepancy was not isolated; do not call the samples geometrically exact.
Raycasts ignore fragment alpha/clipping/depthWrite; nearest texel correspondence, surface positions and normals provide corroboration, not semantic object-ID render output.
At y322 the small remaining tap13 is a wall-parallel fixture face, not the top-ceiling taps driving the y313 peak. Its exact object label is not required and is not asserted here.
The shader still samples depth outside scope elsewhere; no whole AO correctness claim or parameter adjustment was performed.
Three transport cancellations keep overall false/exit1. No retry, source change, shader replacement in product, or evidence rewrite.
suggestion: Send these tap tables to C to reconsider projected sampling radius/ring distribution and Euclidean falloff together. Do not prescribe an untested threshold/strength tweak or declare all remaining bands reasonable contacts.
